turns.instruction:
Analyze the complete attached L-shaped frame directly in YJK. The northeast corner region is intentionally absent. Use only the supplied real nodes, columns, beams and floor boundaries. Preserve the single eccentric +Y force of 12 kN and all actual-beam gravity loads. Report Ux, Uz and Uy at n2-1-2, and global support My and Rz=Fz at n0-0-0.
Use the stated YJK engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.
